21.name: GSM signal
21.description: GSM signal quality level from 0 to 5, where 0 means no connectivity and 5 means excellent signal.

67.name: Battery Voltage
67.description: Current voltage of the internal battery in millivolts (mV).

68.name: Battery current
68.description: Current being provided by internal device battery in milliamperes (mA).

69.name: GNSS Status
69.description: GNSS power status: 0 - Off, 1 - On with fix, 2 - On without fix, 3 - Sleeping.

70.name: PCB temperature
70.description: Temperature of the device (printed circuit board).

80.name: Data acquisition mode
80.description: Provides current data acquisition mode. Home - On stop: 0 Home - Moving: 1 Roaming - On stop: 2 Roaming - Moving: 3 Modes below are available when parameter ID 10600 is set to 1 (Ignition based). Home - On stop, ignition off: 4 Home - Moving, ignition off: 5 Roaming - On stop, ignition off: 6 Roaming - Moving, ignition off: 7

113.name: Battery level
113.description: Battery charge percentage at which indication occurs.

181.name: GNSS PDOP
181.description: GNSS position dilution of precision. Normal PDOP is below 3 – the lower the number, the more accurate reported location is.

182.name: GNSS HDOP
182.description: GNSS horizontal dilution of precision. Normal HDOP is below 2 – the lower the number, the more accurate reported location is.

206.name: GSM area code
206.description: Location area code (LAC) that depends on GSM operator. It provides unique number which is assigned to a set of base GSM stations.

237.name: Network type
237.description: Network type to which device is connected.

240.name: Movement
240.description: Indicates movement state of the device, that determines the data acquisition mode currently used: 0 - on stop. 1 - moving.

386.name: Time from last fix
386.description: How much time has elapsed since the last GNSS fix. Will be "0" if location in record is with GNSS fix (has fix) or there was no fix since startup.

641.name: ICCID
641.description: Integrated circuit card identification number (ICCID) - unique code that includes a SIM card’s country, home network, and identification number.

1148.name: Connectivity quality
1148.description: Provides detailed signal quality information in LTE, eMTC (CAT-Mx) and NB-IoT modes. RSSI (byte 0): 0 - 255 in dBm (negative values) RSRP (byte 1): 0 - 255 in dBm (negative values) SINR (byte 2): 0 - 250 which translates to -20dB to +30dB (1/5th of dB) RSRQ (byte 3): 0 - 255 in dB (negative values)

1149.name: Current LTE Band
1149.description: Provides information about LTE BAND the device is connected to. Possible bands in LTE, eMTC (CAT-Mx) and NBIoT modes: 1 - 85: LTE BAND 1 - LTE BAND 85 0: No LTE Band available.

11399.name: Time to First Fix
11399.description: Time taken in seconds until the first GNSS fix after device is reset.
